name: repeated-run-in-a-tool-result-is-cut
description: A tool result that prints a block the agent already has in context keeps only its new part: the repeated lines become one pointer line. The stored copy lives in a directory the extension names pi-warden-output-<random>: the original randomizes that name on every run (Node mkdtemp), so the scenario's own normalize rule masks it.

arguments.command: i=1; while [ $i -le 80 ]; do echo "report line $i: module $i built and every check passed cleanly"; i=$((i+1)); done

i=1; while [ $i -le 80 ]; do echo "report line $i: module $i built and every check passed cleanly"; i=$((i+1)); done; i=1; while [ $i -le 70 ]; do echo "new status line $i: fresh progress since the last report"; i=$((i+1)); done
